blocks.text: Filipino Comedian Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as Ate Gay, has passed away on November 1, 2026, his family announced. He was 55. READ: Ate Gay placed on life support after septic shock, stroke Ate Gay recently suffered septic shock, acute respiratory failure caused by pneumonia, and a stroke. His family provided an update on his condition in a statement posted on his Facebook page on Friday, Oct. 30, while renewing their appeal for financial assistance.
